name: Like/Dislike Slack Prompt
author: wrycu
description: On song completion, asks the user in Slack whether they liked the song and records the answer.

http.reason: Forward completed-play events to the like/dislike backend service.

subsonicapi.reason: Read the user's play queue to attach best-effort playlist context.

users.reason: Receive scrobble events for users assigned to this plugin.
